listing.name: The King of Fighters '98 (KOF'98 Recomp)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: KOF98-Installer forWindows/Linux/macOS downloads project/toolchain and builds from own kof98h+neogeo sets; Play opens resulting runtime. Manual Setup.cmd/source commands are fallback; upstream launcher owns updates/preparation. Limits: Upstream only: Alpha with sound and CPU team matches. Upstream block comparisons are bounded; boss-fight native verification and broader controller testing remain pending. Not all KOF94-2003 games: only KOF98 implemented. Alpha team matches; boss verification pending; Windows setup expressly untried. Fork parent Metal Slug is framework ancestry, not same game. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux/macOS local-build installers. Windows setup expressly not tried with KOF98; exact installer architecture Unknown. Original data: Neo Geo KOF98 AES set kof98h.zip plus neogeo.zip system BIOS. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
